    XRP vs SOL: what the numbers show

    XRP's market cap of about $59.16B is 1.4 times Solana's ($41.13B); they rank #6 and #7 of the 114 coins tracked here. Over the past year XRP fell 52.4% and Solana fell 44.6%, a gap of 7.8 percentage points in Solana's favour. XRP was the more volatile of the two over the last 30 days (64.7% annualized against 63.5%). Within the year, XRP's largest fall between daily closes was 61.2% and Solana's was 57.6%. On November 22, 2026 XRP was 60.4% below its 52-week high and Solana 51.8% below its own. In 6 of the last 12 complete months, XRP did better than Solana. Measured against Bitcoin's daily moves over 90 days, XRP had a correlation of 0.86 and Solana 0.85.
